name: Chairs & benches

descriptors.name: Product Type
descriptors.question: What kind of item is being sold?
descriptors.definition: An explicit identification of the item, such as a mug, chair, necklace or print.

descriptors.name: Age Group
descriptors.question: Who is this product suitable for by age?
descriptors.definition: An intended age range or life stage, including adult-only or minimum-age restrictions.
examples: Recommended for children between four and seven.
nonAnswers: What ages is it suitable for?

descriptors.name: Assembly
descriptors.question: What assembly does the product require?
descriptors.definition: Instructions or a clear statement about putting the item together, including no assembly.
examples: It arrives in parts to assemble at home.
nonAnswers: Assembly details have not been supplied.

descriptors.name: Capacity
descriptors.question: How much can it hold or support?
descriptors.definition: A stated storage volume, number of contents or supported load; not external dimensions.
nonAnswers: How much weight does it hold?

descriptors.name: Care
descriptors.question: How should this product be cleaned or maintained?
descriptors.definition: Actionable washing, cleaning, storage or maintenance directions.
examples: Wash gently and hang to dry.

descriptors.name: Certifications
descriptors.question: Which named certification or compliance standard is stated?
descriptors.definition: A named certification or standard, or explicit disclosure that the item is not certified; a generic sourcing claim is insufficient.
examples: FSC certification applies to the timber.

descriptors.name: Compatibility
descriptors.question: Which other products or fittings does it work with?
descriptors.definition: Functional fit or interoperability with another item, size standard or system; not aesthetic coordination.
nonAnswers: Will it work with my setup?

descriptors.name: Contents
descriptors.question: What is included or excluded from the order?
descriptors.definition: Explicit package contents, accessories or quantity supplied; not how much the product can hold.
examples: All fixing hardware comes in the box.
A lid is included; the stand is not.
nonAnswers: It has room for two pieces.

descriptors.name: Dimensions
descriptors.question: What are the overall measurements?
descriptors.definition: Physical length, width, depth, diameter or thickness, excluding a specifically labeled seat or chain measurement.
examples: Overall size is 70 by 40 by 90 centimeters.

descriptors.name: Features
descriptors.question: What functional features does it have?
descriptors.definition: Concrete functions or construction features, such as adjustment, reinforced joints, support or a removable cover; vague praise is insufficient.
examples: It folds flat and has removable covers.
nonAnswers: A lovely item with timeless appeal.

descriptors.name: Finish
descriptors.question: How is the surface finished?
descriptors.definition: A surface treatment, coating, sheen or statement that the surface is unfinished.
examples: The outside is glazed and glossy.
nonAnswers: I will finish the order soon.

descriptors.name: Material
descriptors.question: What is the product made of?
descriptors.definition: The substance, fabric, metal or composition used to make the item.

descriptors.name: Personalization
descriptors.question: How can the buyer customize it?
descriptors.definition: Specific custom text, engraving, color or size choices, or an explicit statement that customization is unavailable.
examples: Choose custom wording and a color.
nonAnswers: We make every customer feel special.

descriptors.name: Seat Height
descriptors.question: How far above the floor is the seat?
descriptors.definition: The floor-to-sitting-surface measurement, not the total height of a chair or its back.
examples: The seating surface is 19 inches above the ground.
nonAnswers: The chair measures 90 centimeters tall overall.

descriptors.name: Style
descriptors.question: What design style does it have?
descriptors.definition: An aesthetic design movement or style, such as rustic, modern or minimalist; distinct from an illustrated subject.

descriptors.name: Theme
descriptors.question: What subject, motif or theme is depicted?
descriptors.definition: A recognizable subject or decorative motif, such as woodland animals, nautical imagery or botanical patterns.

sample: A rustic oak dining chair for adults. The seat is 18 inches above the floor. Overall dimensions are 34 by 18 by 20 inches. Supports 250 pounds. A reinforced backrest provides support. All assembly hardware is included. Wipe clean with a damp cloth.

provenance.source: Independently authored demo taxonomy using common marketplace product concepts.
provenance.note: Not affiliated with Etsy; no Etsy API data, scraped listings or reconstructed taxonomy identifiers.
